cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('mrbgems').glob('*.gembox'):
 print('---',p)
 for i,l in enumerate(p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines(),1):
  if 'bigint' in l: print(i,l)
PY
